graph.description: One graph, described by its type and the values that type accepts; null means "not given". Text is plain text: control, line-break, text-direction and invisible characters are not accepted. A color is a color name (black, gray, red, orange, green, blue, purple, brown) in any case, or a hex code such as #0072b2. The package's validator also checks what this schema cannot: tag characters, rare variation selectors and broken surrogates in text; values that determine one another must agree within 1%; ranges must have their minimum below their maximum; type-specific rules such as points inside the axes; and at most 10000 values in one description. Schema and validator agree on the JSON form of a description.

anyOf.title: Pictograph
anyOf.description: A pictograph: one row of pictures per category (or one column, upright), each picture standing for a number of units, with a key such as "each apple = 2 students". A value that is not a whole number of pictures ends in one cropped picture. At most 100 categories and 1000 pictures in all.

type.description: The graph type: which kind of graph the description draws.

version.description: The schema version the description is written for. Leave it out for the current version, 1. Null means the current version.

title.description: A title shown above the graph, as plain text. In the drawing, a title longer than three lines is cut short with “…”; the text alternative states it whole.

valueUnitLabel.description: What one unit of value counts, as plain text, such as "students"; the key reads "each ★ = 2 students". Left out or empty, the key says "units".

categories.description: The categories, drawn in the order given: at least 1 and at most 100, each with a different name.

name.description: The category's name, as plain text. A long name wraps onto more lines; it is never cut short.

values.description: One value per category, in the same order: how many units the category has.

unitImage.description: The picture every unit is drawn with, by name from the published image set.

unitValue.description: How many units one picture stands for: greater than 0, at most 1000000000.

orientation.description: Whether the pictures run in rows (horizontal, the default) or columns (vertical).

anyOf.title: Circle
anyOf.description: A circle drawn to scale from its radius, diameter or circumference (give one; any other given must agree within 1%). The radius, the diameter and the center can be drawn, and each measurement labeled with its value and unit or with custom text. Give one of radius, diameter or circumference; the others are worked out from it.

type.description: The graph type: which kind of graph the description draws.

version.description: The schema version the description is written for. Leave it out for the current version, 1. Null means the current version.

title.description: A title shown above the graph, as plain text. In the drawing, a title longer than three lines is cut short with “…”; the text alternative states it whole.

lineColor.description: The color of a line: the number line itself, a figure's outline, or one series of a line graph. A color name or a hex code such as #0072b2.

radius.description: The distance from the center to the circle, from 0.001 to 1,000,000.

diameter.description: The distance across the circle through its center, twice the radius, from 0.002 to 2,000,000.

circumference.description: The distance around the circle, 2π times the radius, from 0.006 to 6,283,186.

showRadius.description: Whether the radius is drawn, from the center horizontally to the right.

showDiameter.description: Whether the diameter is drawn through the center; it never lies on the radius.

showCenter.description: Whether the center is marked with a point.

labelRadius.description: Whether the radius is labeled with its measurement; a labeled radius is drawn.

labelDiameter.description: Whether the diameter is labeled with its measurement; a labeled diameter is drawn.

labelCircumference.description: Whether the circumference is labeled with its measurement, next to the circle.

radiusLabelText.description: Text shown in place of the radius label, such as "r" or "?"; it also labels the radius. It replaces the whole label, unit included, so add the unit to the text if it should show. An empty text is a blank label, for example a space to fill in. Text too long to fit beside the figure is placed below it, and text longer than four lines is cut short with “…”. The text alternative still states the value.

diameterLabelText.description: Text shown in place of the diameter label, such as "r" or "?"; it also labels the diameter. It replaces the whole label, unit included, so add the unit to the text if it should show. An empty text is a blank label, for example a space to fill in. Text too long to fit beside the figure is placed below it, and text longer than four lines is cut short with “…”. The text alternative still states the value.

circumferenceLabelText.description: Text shown in place of the circumference label, such as "r" or "?"; it also labels the circumference. It replaces the whole label, unit included, so add the unit to the text if it should show. An empty text is a blank label, for example a space to fill in. Text too long to fit beside the figure is placed below it, and text longer than four lines is cut short with “…”. The text alternative still states the value.

unit.description: The unit of length shown after each measurement, such as cm. A unit longer than 20 characters, or with sentence punctuation, is quoted in the text alternative.
